brief.topic: Agent self-service collaboration control plane for multi-device multi-agent co-design and co-work

criteria.question: Does the project support the Human-triggered Agent self-service loop: publish available work, discover eligible work, claim exactly one work item, publish result or blocker, and let another Agent continue review?
How are Agent-private context and permission-scoped shared coordination context separated, persisted, and referenced without replacing Git as the durable engineering fact source?
How are Human, device, Agent instance, project or initiative scope, ownership, and access boundaries represented?
What central service, transport, storage, recovery, and deployment model enables multiple devices and heterogeneous Agents to access shared coordination state?
Can the project expose product-health facts such as eligible discovery, claim conflict, handoff continuation, context defects, blockers, and Human intervention?
What protocols, SDKs, CLI or MCP interfaces, extension seams, licenses, release practices, and upgrade responsibilities affect integration into a new base project?
What evidence shows that the project can support a narrow first Experience Version without requiring a full workflow platform or production-grade reliability program?
